x: How to Craft

Ferrous anvils cannot be cast. They must be smithed on another anvil, in two parts: a base and a top. You then must place the base on the ground while hot, put flux (such as borax) on top of it, then add the anvil top (also hot) and then use a hammer several times to fuse the two halves together.
